references.context: Category theory: invertible endomorphisms of a given object in a groupoid

references.phrase: equivalence relation on objects by existence of an arrow
references.context: Set theory: equivalence relation determined by isomorphism of groupoid objects

references.phrase: at most one arrow between objects
references.disposition: For a groupoid with trivial automorphisms, this follows by cancellation of invertible arrows; no skeletal assumption is present.

review_rationale: Reviewed both equivalent descriptions: a groupoid with trivial automorphism groups, and at most one arrow between any ordered object pair. Distinguish existence as an equivalence relation from a poset's antisymmetry.
